body:
**Severity**: LOW · **Dimension**: Acceptance gates and harness · **Tier Violated**: no-fabrication (a capture attributed to shader X may be shader X−1) · **Game Affected**: all

### Description
`docs/smoke-tests/m-exteriors.sh:102-108`, `docs/smoke-tests/w1-water-traversal.sh:89-95` and `scripts/renderer-eval-groundcover.sh:90-95` each still say "A renderer build.rs rerun-if-changed on shaders/** is the structural fix, tracked separately." `a04ccaec3` already landed that `rerun-if-changed` (`crates/renderer/build.rs:31`, confirmed present at HEAD `ee6d3fb39`). It regenerates `shader_constants.glsl` (write-if-changed) and dirties the crate, so there is no rebuild loop, but it cannot recompile a `.spv` — an edited-but-not-recompiled shader still ships stale SPIR-V. The repo already has the real check, `scripts/check-shader-artifacts.sh` (used by `ci.yml`), but none of the three harnesses runs it before capturing.

### Evidence
Ran `scripts/check-shader-artifacts.sh` (glslang 11:16.2.0, matched). Result: `DRIFT crates/renderer/shaders/composite.frag.spv` — two commits changed its generated constants without recompiling it, and CI was red from 2026-09-20 22:29 until the fix landed (`eb3c2d199`, #4577). Every exterior-owned `.spv` (water, sky, clouds, ground cover) reproduces byte-identically as of this pass.

### Impact
A visual claim from any of the three harnesses can still be judged through a stale shader — the exact #4490 premise. The m-exteriors cycle mode captures through `composite.frag`.

### Related
#4490 (closed), #4577 (REN-D12-2026-09-21-01, the composite.frag drift this pass found and that was since fixed), EXT-D7-2026-09-21-01

### Suggested Fix
Call `scripts/check-shader-artifacts.sh` in each harness preflight, failing or stamping the manifest on DRIFT. Update the three comments to describe the landed `build.rs` change accurately (it dirties the crate on shader source edits; it does not recompile SPIR-V).

## Completeness Checks
- [ ] **SIBLING**: All three harnesses (`m-exteriors.sh`, `w1-water-traversal.sh`, `renderer-eval-groundcover.sh`) get the same preflight check, not just one
- [ ] **TESTS**: A harness run against a deliberately stale `.spv` fails the preflight instead of silently capturing
